description: Source code for LDAP-related operations in Mattermost server, including LDAP sync, testing, group retrieval, user switching between LDAP and email, LDAP migration, and certificate management.

methods.name: SyncLdap
methods.description: Starts an LDAP synchronization job if LDAP is enabled and licensed.

methods.name: TestLdap
methods.description: Tests LDAP configuration if LDAP is enabled.

methods.name: TestLdapConnection
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with provided settings.

methods.name: GetLdapGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a specific LDAP group by ID.

methods.name: SwitchEmailToLdap
methods.description: Switches user authentication from email to LDAP.

methods.name: SwitchLdapToEmail
methods.description: Switches user authentication from LDAP to email.

methods.name: AddLdapPublicCertificate
methods.description: Adds an LDAP public certificate file.

methods.name: AddLdapPrivateCertificate
methods.description: Adds an LDAP private key file.

methods.name: RemoveLdapPublicCertificate
methods.description: Removes the LDAP public certificate file.

methods.name: RemoveLdapPrivateCertificate
methods.description: Removes the LDAP private key file.
